procedure_name: Vehicle Loan Hypothecation Removal (HP Termination / Form 35)
summary: Removing bank finance lien from vehicle Registration Certificate after full repayment of vehicle loan.

steps.title: Obtain bank loan closure kit
steps.description: Collect Form 35 (two copies signed by bank officer) and Bank No Objection Certificate (NOC).

steps.title: Submit HP cancellation on Vahan
steps.description: Enter vehicle number, upload Bank NOC and signed Form 35, and pay smart card fee.

steps.title: Bank electronic endorsement
steps.description: Financier approves electronic loan clearance on national Vahan banking portal.

steps.title: Submit original RC to RTO
steps.description: Hand over physical RC to RTO counter or send via registered post.

steps.title: Receive clean RC smart card
steps.description: Receive brand new Registration Certificate showing clean ownership without bank hypothecation.
